verdict.rationale: Yapily's own docs say developers can collect variable recurring payments without re-authorising each time, and that the Payments API supports single, scheduled and periodic payments. That clearly covers the core of recurring bank payments, though Hosted Pages does not yet support periodic payments, so the direct API is needed. missing for 10: detailed VRP consent and payment API reference (endpoints, limits, sweeping vs commercial VRP), documentation of standing-order lifecycle management, independent or hands-on corroboration.
